features.quote: In most of the latter are cistern openings

date.basis: cisterns not dated; the entry only presumes the later-stage buildings Middle Ages or slightly earlier

features.cite: Zertal 1996 (Eng. Vol. 2) Site 251, Fig. 513 p. 601 (plan label)
features.subtype: cistern labelled on plan outside the core

notes: f1 lies in the courtyards of the later settlement on the hilltop (the site itself), so position none. f2: Fig. 513 labels one 'Cistern' just outside the building core, c. 75 m from its centre. The unit point (= entry grid, 100 m precision) cannot be placed on the plan (no grid), and the distance is below its precision, so no plan position. Two small unlabelled circles at the lower left of the plan are not coded. No pools or graves.
